headline: Run77 finds Stage 3 ready for a final evidence-freeze package: N12/N16 reached 78 native teacher rows each, N24/N40 remain mature anchors, and claims must stay bounded to tested native N values and the current 2D teacher model.
paper_safe_claim: Teacher-validated scan-order improvement can be discussed across the tested native N values with bounds on N values, strategy space, and the current 2D Abaqus teacher model.
